fieldValues.title: 1. Sense: what we tried and where we went too far
fieldValues.thinking_reached:
The ideal: Nothing that matters goes unnoticed: the owner's experience is captured as it was said, and every session knows where things stand before it acts.

What we have tried: Narrative explorations and vignettes (decision 77e04b19); the clerk desk and its pinned issue; the srs-context brief and dream cycle; intake (clerk#56); the work-flow audit and the archaeology; run reports.

Problems recorded here: SP-103, SP-66, SP-61, SP-52, SP-59.
fieldValues.tensions:
- Line 2, Keep everything and one current picture: too far toward Keep everything. The week to 2026-10-23: 176 of 254 merged PRs were process and memory, not product (work-flow audit).
- Model B: 202 problem records for 105 SP ids; about 15 merged PRs promised follow-ups never filed (archaeology 1.4); the first real-use session left no record (audit).
- The stage's other two tensions stay as records under its domain, out of this map (one trade-off per stage, owner, 2026-10-25).
